basic_details.job_title: IIT BHU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow/ Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi (IIT BHU) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi (IIT BHU) on its official website for the recruitment of 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post under Advertisement No. R&D/ECE/TTDF/24-25/32/677. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking a contract-based research position in the field of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Tech with First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline, M.Tech with First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline, 2 Years of research experience (for SRF)
qualification.details: For JRF: B.Tech First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline. For SRF: M.Tech First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline + 2 years research experience OR B.Tech First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline + 2 years research experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: For JRF: B.Tech First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline. For SRF: M.Tech First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline + 2 years research experience OR B.Tech First class in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline + 2 years research experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU JRF/SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 12-08-2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF/SRF posts?
faq.answer: For JRF, a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied discipline is required. For SRF, an M.Tech with 2 years of research experience or a B.Tech with 2 years of research experience in the same field is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT BHU JRF/SRF positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their application with complete bio-data and relevant documents via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/SRF posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, usually provided by the organization on their website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contract basis, meaning they are temporary appointments for a specific duration.

faq.question: Q10. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi (IIT BHU).
